lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li₂ZnO₂ crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms (Li₄Zn₂O₄) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li and Zn centers each coordinated by four O neighbors, while O centers adopt an octahedral environment with six geometric neighbors (3 Li, 3 Zn). Corner-sharing is observed between O-centered octahedra and between Li- and Zn-centered 4-vertex coordination polyhedra, and the neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component.
